j5.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Create ONE entirely NEW 16:9 LANDSCAPE image, ideally native 1536 × 864 pixels. A photorealistic full-size architectural cutaway scene, with real camera-like surfaces and light, not a toy diorama, not cartoon art. Forbidden City, Beijing, summer around 1914. Warm playful cinematic tone, real human dignity. Deep red palace walls, imperial yellow glazed tiled roofs, painted blue-green eaves, green trees. No modern objects.
Input images are REFERENCE IMAGES ONLY for the already accepted series' light, costume, human appearance, environment and elevated rear camera. They are not edit targets: invent a completely new wide composition, do not retouch or extend an old picture, do not preserve the portrait framing or reproduce the old stud layout.
Composition: camera well back and high, looking obliquely down from BEHIND the moving child; show FOUR distinct palace buildings completely or almost completely in a coherent environment, with space around their outlines. A distant elevated game-follow camera, while the small child remains clearly visible in the middle of the action. ONE nearest foreground building is exposed in a clean architect's dollhouse sectional convention: its entire roof and ceiling are absent, its walls and posts are cut flat at one clean straight horizontal plane so we can look down into a furnished room. Crisp planar cut wall tops, intact finished floor, stable walls, no broken timbers, no demolition, no ruin. Other buildings retain intact roofs. The cutaway is an explanatory architectural convention applied to otherwise lifelike architecture, not a claim of a real photo of a roofless palace.
People: ONE small child Puyi, about eight years old, wears a bright imperial yellow SILK robe with dragon embroidery, a small round black cap with gold top, and a long black braided queue flying behind him; no glasses. He is moving away from camera. Behind him follow THREE adult male Qing palace eunuch attendants in dark navy or gray robes and round caps, plus ONE female nurse in a Manchu robe and headdress: four adults total. Warm amused, slightly breathless, dignified people; no exaggerated faces, no ridicule. No copied film-actor likenesses. Natural limbs, child proportions, natural cloth wrinkles.
Full-size realistic materials: subtly irregular worn stone paving, aged painted timber, low polished bronze highlights, individually glazed roof tiles, silk fibers and natural trees; no repeated etched surface pattern, no painterly strokes, no artificial plastic shine. Summer green foliage, no snow, no autumn leaves. No vignette, text, watermark, frames or montage panels.
SAFETY AND ACTION: the child and adults are on a broad flat continuous paved route safely enclosed by substantial parapets, or at ground level in the courtyard. Everyone stable and playful. No child on a pitched roof or ridge, no unprotected drop beside the child, no falling, ladders, fear, distressed adults, injury or danger. No bicycle, car, modern wire, tourist or modern skyline.

Scene J5, gate and courtyard, bright warm summer daytime. The four buildings comprise an imposing red gatehouse, two intact yellow-roofed side halls, and the nearest foreground side hall/guardroom with its roof neatly cut away. Inside this nearest guardroom show an orderly Qing-period 1914 entrance room: lacquered wooden table, chairs, small cabinet, silk curtain, woven rug and period ceramic vessel, lit naturally. The room must be visibly furnished through its absent roof, not simply a bare open courtyard.
Beyond this cutaway room we look from behind Puyi as he runs into a sunlit stone courtyard immediately after stepping over a high WOODEN threshold through an open red gateway. His yellow robe and braid clearly identify him. Show the solid wood grain of the raised threshold and a complete open pair of monumental red door leaves. Each leaf has exactly NINE rows and NINE columns of rounded golden studs, 81 studs per leaf, with uniform spacing; keep the full rectangular grids visible, no extra row or missing column. Do not copy the old reference's incorrect six-by-ten stud arrangement. The four adults come through the gateway behind Puyi: three male attendants and one female nurse; one male has just caught his toe on the threshold but remains upright, amusingly off balance, no injury.
A large broad OPEN bronze fire-water vat stands in the courtyard on a low stone plinth, lidless and without winter covers. Show two opposed ring handles on its ears, water surface visible; not a tripod ritual vessel and not a bath for people. Keep the full vat readable. Composition prioritizes the four-building view and the clean furnished cutaway while making the gateway, Puyi, wood threshold and vat distinct.
j5.inputRole: style/environment references only, not edit targets
